variants.name: Duck 400 g
variants.about_this_item: Bwild Grain Free PUPPY Duck with Pumpkin and Zucchini is a grain-free formula, tasty pieces of duck meat in sauce for puppies of all breeds . Created with the wellbeing of puppies of all breeds in mind, thanks to the selection of alternative, grain-free carbohydrate sources such as pumpkin and courgette. Recipe enriched with Xyloligosaccharides for intestinal health and Chondroitin and Glucosamine for proper joint development.
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Duck meat (26%), pork liver, chicken meat, salmon oil, yeast products, dried pumpkin 2% (equal to 8.6% of fresh pumpkin), dried zucchini 2% (equal to 8.6% of fresh zucchini), minerals, potatoes, fresh blueberries, fresh cranberries, fresh raspberries, xylo-oligosaccharide (XOS 0.1%), yucca schidigera, spirulina (0.1%), glucosamine (0.019%), chondroitin sulphate (0.01%).

Analytical constituents: Crude protein: 8.3%, Crude fibre: 0.8%, Crude fat: 6.5%, Crude ash: 2.5%, Moisture: 79%, Calcium/Phosphorus Ratio: 1, Metabolisable Energy (Atwater calculation): 1033 kcal/kg.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES: Vitamin D3 434 IU/kg, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl-acetate) 15.5 mg/kg, Selenium (Sodium selenite 0.05 mg/kg) 0.02 mg/kg, Manganese (manganous sulphate monohydrate 11 mg/kg) 3.5 mg/kg, Zinc (Zinc oxide 20 mg/kg): 16 mg/kg, Copper (Copper (II) sulphate pentahydrate 5.5 mg/kg) 1.4 mg/kg, Iron (Iron (II) sulphate monohydrate 35 mg/kg) 11.5 mg/kg, Iodine (Calcium iodate anhydrous 0.3 mg/kg) 0.19 mg/kg.
